rules.mechanism: Sends anonymized usage statistics to Google Analytics at the end of predict/train/val/export runs, tied to a persistent install uuid (%APPDATA%\Ultralytics\settings.json). The switch is honored only when written as a JSON boolean — a quoted "false" reads back as ON.
rules.riskNote: Low — model training and inference are unaffected; this only disables the stats upload and Hub sync.

rules.mechanism: YOLO_OFFLINE=1 makes the library skip all of its own network calls — usage statistics, package auto-install and version checks. Honored by the library itself; no settings file involved.
rules.scope: User — affects every new Python process
rules.riskNote: Low-medium — also disables auto-install and update checks; model weights must already be on disk.

rules.mechanism: dotnet commands report usage data to Microsoft unless DOTNET_CLI_TELEMETRY_OPTOUT is set.
rules.riskNote: None — tooling behavior is identical with telemetry off.

rules.mechanism: PowerShell 7 sends usage data to Microsoft unless POWERSHELL_TELEMETRY_OPTOUT is set.
VS Code sends usage and crash data unless telemetry.telemetryLevel is set to "off".
Windows sends diagnostic data to Microsoft. The AllowTelemetry policy caps it: 1 = required/security only, 0 = security only (Enterprise). Absent = full default level.
rules.riskNote: Medium — lower levels reduce Microsoft-side diagnostics; some Windows features rely on diagnostic data.

rules.mechanism: Edge reports usage and diagnostic data unless the MetricsReportingEnabled policy disables it.
Chrome reports usage statistics to Google unless the MetricsReportingEnabled policy disables it.

The Start/search box (SearchHost.exe hosting an Edge WebView2) polls Bing endpoints for web-search suggestions and search-highlight content and fetches its configuration over Akamai-fronted CDNs. This is FEATURE traffic, not diagnostic data — telemetry opt-outs do not touch it. The DisableSearchBoxSuggestions policy turns the web-suggestion feature itself off, removing the polling at the source.
rules.riskNote: Web suggestions and search highlights disappear from the search box; local file and app search are unaffected. An already-open search flyout keeps the old behavior until SearchHost restarts.

rules.mechanism: Windows fetches 'cloud optimized content' — search highlights, tips and suggested content — over the same CDN paths the search UI already uses. The DisableCloudOptimizedContent policy stops these fetches by disabling the content pipeline itself; a feature switch, not a telemetry opt-out.
rules.riskNote: Search highlights, tips and some suggested content disappear. Local search unaffected.

rules.appName: Windows search — web results in the search box
rules.mechanism: IsDynamicSearchBoxEnabled=0 turns off the dynamic (web-powered) search box for the current user — the search UI stops issuing zero-input Bing queries (trending, suggestions, highlights feeds) every time the box opens. A user-scope preference the search UI reads fresh.
rules.riskNote: The search box shows only local results (files, apps, settings); web results and suggestions are gone until reverted.
